title: Unreal build
description: Builds a .uproject's editor target through UnrealBuildTool, or packages a .uplugin through AutomationTool's BuildPlugin once per engine its hosts name and archives each package; every task of a run goes one at a time, since UnrealBuildTool runs once per engine and BuildPlugin's own runs never wait

outputPath.description: Workspace-relative folder a plug-in's archives are written to

descriptor.description: The project's .uproject or .uplugin, relative to the workspace root

hosts.description: The .uproject files building a plug-in, whose engine associations name each engine BuildPlugin runs on; empty for a plug-in no project builds, which takes its EngineVersion

dependencies.description: Workspace plug-ins a .uplugin names, passed to BuildPlugin as -Dependencies

engines.description: Engine roots by association, read before Epic's install registry

args.description: Arguments after -- appended to the UnrealBuildTool or AutomationTool command
